parts.name: axle nail
parts.notes: 0.087in dia, ~1in long; driven into body slot, wheel spins on shank

joins.notes: nail driven into pre-cut slot (often glued after alignment)

assembly.stepsSource: no official numbered instructions; kit is a raw block + 4 wheels + 4 nails. Typical order is shape, weight, paint, axle install.
order: insert axle nails through wheels into slots
